'''Reflections Booster Draft''' is a booster draft format played with [[Reflections]] packs. [[Decipher]] ran it as a sanctioned side event at [[DecipherCon 2000]] and defined a [[Reflections II Booster Draft]] for Reflections II packs in 2001; the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015) keeps a Reflections Booster Draft with [[Reflections]], [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] or [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III]] boosters.<ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="res-sw">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Star Wars Customizable Card Game Tournament Resources], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011116144130/http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (2000; Reflections II and III drafts 2001); Players Committee (Official SW: CCG Tournament Guide, 2007&ndash;2008; Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' DecipherCon 2000: 3 Reflections boosters and a Darth Vader or Luke Skywalker [[Enhanced Premiere]] pack per player. Players Committee: 4 Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III boosters per player, plus up to six battleground locations brought by the player
* '''In use:''' 2000 &ndash; listed in 2015 (Reflections II and III drafts: 2001 &ndash;)
* '''Also called:''' Reflections Sealed Booster Draft (Decipher's DecipherCon 2000 schedule);<ref name="dcon00-sched">[http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf DecipherCon Master Tournament Schedule for Decipher Games], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030413152501/http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Reflections II Booster Draft and Reflections III Booster Draft (Players Committee)<ref name="afg" /> (for Decipher's 2001 Reflections II format see [[Reflections II Booster Draft]])
* '''GEMP:''' none. [[Reflections Sealed]] on play.swccg.com is a sealed (not drafted) Reflections league.

== Card pool ==
=== Decipher (2000) ===
"Players will be seated into groups of 4, with each player receiving 3 Star Wars Reflections boosters and either a Darth Vader or Luke Skywalker Enhanced Premiere pack to draft the best decks possible. Will you draft the foil, or let it go?"<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />

Decipher's ''Reflections II Booster Draft Format'' page was linked from its 2001 tournament resources, but every preserved capture of that page (reflections2.asp, 2002&ndash;2003) is an error page.<ref name="res-sw" /><ref name="dec-ressw">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Star Wars tournament resources], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020808154840/http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref> The rules survive on Decipher's Reflections II expansion page (January 2001): 4 packs of Reflections II per player, any 6 battleground locations brought by each player, and 40-card decks built in 10 minutes. They are on [[Reflections II Booster Draft]].<ref name="r2bdf">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/expansions/reflections2/boosterdraftformat.html Rules for Reflections II Sealed Deck: Booster Draft Format], Decipher (January 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010124152400/http://www.decipher.com:80/starwars/expansions/reflections2/boosterdraftformat.html Internet Archive].</ref>

For its Reflections III pre-release weekend (27&ndash;28 October 2001, eight tournaments in North America) Decipher used the same draft with Reflections III packs: "This will be a sealed deck 'booster draft' format tournament. Each player will get four booster packs of Reflections III to draft. Players will be allowed to bring six battleground locations for each side of the force. These battlegrounds can only be from Tatooine, Naboo, or Coruscant."<ref name="r3pre">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/expansions/reflections3/prereleases.html Star Wars CCG Reflections III Pre-Release Weekend], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020209150206/http://www.decipher.com:80/starwars/expansions/reflections3/prereleases.html Internet Archive].</ref>

=== Players Committee (2007&ndash;2015) ===
The Players Committee's ''Official SW: CCG Tournament Guide'' of 2007 and 2008 lists two separate formats. Reflections II Booster Draft uses 4 Reflections II booster packs and six battleground locations. Reflections III Booster Draft uses 4 Reflections III booster packs, and "Each player may bring with him six Tatooine, Coruscant and/or Naboo battleground locations that may be included in the player's deck."<ref name="pctg07">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/Official%20SWCCG%20Tournament%20Guide.pdf Official SW: CCG Tournament Guide], Version 3 (07/10/2007), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026144111/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/Official%20SWCCG%20Tournament%20Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="pctg08">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/tournaments/OfficialSWCCGTournamentGuide.pdf Official SW: CCG Tournament Guide], Version 4.0 (04/01/2008), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080509195802/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/tournaments/OfficialSWCCGTournamentGuide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

The Alternate Format Tournament Guide requires 4 Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III booster packs per player, played under its [[Booster Draft]] rules. "Each player may bring with them six battleground locations that may be included in the player's deck. The Tournament Director should verify these locations' status as battlegrounds prior to beginning the tournament."<ref name="afg" /> Under those rules players draft in groups of 4 or 6, Light and Dark seated alternately, and take one card of their own side from each pack and pass. The guide does not give a deck size for this format; deck building time is 10 minutes for 40-card decks and 20 minutes for 60-card decks.<ref name="afg" /> Its list of sealed formats names the format as '''Reflections II Booster Draft''' and '''Reflections III Booster Draft'''.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
At DecipherCon 2000 Decipher scheduled the Reflections Booster Draft on Thursday 5 October at 6 p.m. (event #SW213) and Friday 6 October at 9 a.m. (event #SW221), four games each, entry $20, sanctioned.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" /><ref name="dcon00-sched" />

Decipher introduced a [[Reflections II Booster Draft]] when Reflections II was released in January 2001, and in 2001, and again in August 2002, its Star Wars tournament resources page linked a "Reflections II Booster Draft Format" among its format notes.<ref name="r2bdf" /><ref name="res-sw" /><ref name="dec-ressw" /> Decipher's Reflections III pre-release weekend of October 2001 was a four-pack Reflections III booster draft.<ref name="r3pre" /> The Players Committee listed Reflections II and Reflections III booster drafts separately in 2007 and 2008, and combined them as Reflections Booster Draft in its 2015 guide.<ref name="pctg07" /><ref name="pctg08" /><ref name="afg" /> No event in the Players Committee format is recorded on this wiki.
